platforms.name: 4ZZZ Brisbane Music Submission Form Route
platforms.country: Australia / Brisbane community radio music submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No public submission fee confirmed; station music-department review applies.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official JavaScript submission form requests downloadable audio, artwork, metadata and artist links; owner review is required before entering or uploading any material. Any human-verification control must remain manual.
platforms.notes: Official music-submission page and form were active when checked on 2026-07-10. The public business address music-department@4zzz.org.au was verified on the official contact page as a follow-up contact; it was not probed or used.
